findings.label: Fully open RLS write policies
findings.description: module_prices allows any anonymous user to upsert prices. module_orders allows any anonymous user to update any row status to approved, meaning a buyer can approve their own order via the Supabase REST API using the anon key visible in the client bundle.
findings.action: Restrict write policies to a server-side function or shared secret. At minimum change module_orders update policy so buyers cannot self-approve.

findings.label: Hardcoded admin credentials in source bundle
findings.description: ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD are plaintext constants in SubscriptionsPage.tsx shipped in the Vite bundle. The sessionStorage auth flag is bypassable via DevTools.
findings.action: Move credentials to VITE_ environment variables or replace with Supabase Auth.

findings.label: approveOrder does not unlock for buyer
findings.description: handleApprove calls unlockModule which writes to admin localStorage only. The buyers LockedRoute reads their own localStorage which is unaffected.
findings.action: Query module_orders for approved orders on buyer app load and call unlockModule for each approved entry.

findings.label: Screenshot base64 stored in DB rows
findings.description: Payment screenshots are stored as full base64 data URLs in screenshot_data_url column. A JPEG becomes 1+ MB per row fetched on every 30s refresh.
findings.action: Use Supabase Storage and store only the public URL in the existing screenshot_url column.

findings.label: useMyOrders fragile query chain cast
findings.description: The query is reassigned via double unknown cast for conditional .eq() filtering. Brittle against Supabase client updates.
findings.action: Use a conditional single .eq() call without intermediate reassignment.
